scheduler.error.STORE_UNAVAILABLE: Scheduler data store (Redis) is not connected.
scheduler.error.RUNTIME_DOWN: No Scheduler instance is running — start the Scheduler runtime first.
scheduler.error.NO_RESPONSE: The Scheduler runtime did not confirm the command in time — check the Scheduler runtime and its logs.
scheduler.error.MISCONFIGURED: The task schedule is invalid ({error}) — fix it in code and redeploy.
scheduler.error.RUNTIME_PAUSED: The Scheduler runtime is stopped (paused) — start it from Runtimes first.
scheduler.error.TASK_RUNNING: The task is currently running (execution {execution}). Overlap policy is Prevent — manual execution cannot start until the current execution finishes.
scheduler.error.LOCK_UNAVAILABLE: The distributed lock could not be acquired (Redis unavailable) — the task was not started.
scheduler.error.REJECTED: The Scheduler runtime rejected the command.
scheduler.error.executionNotFound: Execution {id} was not found (it may be older than the history retention).
scheduler.health.storeUnavailable: Scheduler data store (Redis) is not connected — status is unknown.
scheduler.health.neverStarted: No Scheduler instance has reported yet — the Scheduler runtime has not been started.
scheduler.health.noHeartbeat: No heartbeat received for {age}. Scheduled tasks may be missed.
scheduler.health.paused: The Scheduler runtime is stopped (paused) — no task is triggered until it is started.
scheduler.alert.HEARTBEAT_MISSING.title: Scheduler heartbeat missing
scheduler.alert.HEARTBEAT_MISSING.messag: No Scheduler instance has reported for {value} (timeout {threshold}s). Scheduled tasks may be missed.
scheduler.alert.MISCONFIGURED.title: Task misconfigured
scheduler.alert.RECENT_FAILURES.title: Task executions failing
scheduler.alert.RECENT_FAILURES.message: {value} task executions failed during the last hour. Affected: {tasks}.
scheduler.alert.LONG_RUNNING.title: Long-running task
scheduler.alert.LONG_RUNNING.message: {task} has been running for {duration} — normally under {expected}. Potentially stalled.
scheduler.alert.MISSED_RUN.title: Missed schedule
scheduler.alert.MISSED_RUN.message: {task} missed {value} scheduled run(s) in the last hour.
scheduler.alert.OVERDUE.title: Task overdue
scheduler.alert.OVERDUE.message: {task} should have run {value} ago but has not been triggered.
scheduler.alert.OVERLAP.title: Overlapping executions
scheduler.alert.OVERLAP.message: {task} has {value} executions running at the same time (expected 1).
scheduler.alert.DUPLICATE_EXECUTION.mess: {task} ran {value} times for the schedule at {at} (expected 1). Instances: {instances}.
scheduler.alert.LOCK_UNAVAILABLE.title: Distributed lock unavailable
scheduler.alert.LOCK_UNAVAILABLE.message: {task} was skipped {value} time(s) because the lock could not be acquired.
scheduler.alert.HIGH_DRIFT.title: Scheduler start drift high
scheduler.alert.HIGH_DRIFT.message: P95 start delay is {value}ms (threshold {threshold}ms) — the Scheduler runtime may be overloaded.
scheduler.event.run_missed: {task} missed {count} scheduled run(s) from {from} to {until} — misfire policy: {policy}
scheduler.event.run_recovered: {task} ran once to recover {count} missed run(s)
scheduler.downstream.unsupported: The queue provider does not expose this data.
scheduler.downstream.notFound: Queue not found on the broker.
